statement: Descriptor-backed notes for official 28de:1304 Puck declare input report IDs 0x40, 0x41, 0x42, 0x43, 0x44, 0x45, 0x79, 0x7b and output IDs/body lengths 0x80:9, 0x81:7, 0x82:3, 0x83:9, 0x84:8, 0x85:3, 0x86:3, 0x87:63, 0x88:63, 0x89:63 body bytes (wire lengths include one more report-ID byte). Shapes are not recorded host output; do not infer feature ACKs, host initialization or seven-interface USB composite topology. Shared input/output declaration matches parts of pinned OpenPuck and kernel/SDL sources, without proving the same physical interface.
